error.message: The drawing depicts a vase with a complex, organic silhouette (bulbous body, narrow neck, flared rim). The available BRep operations (box, cylinder, extrude, sweep, loft, arc_pipe) cannot construct a solid of revolution with a spline or complex polygonal profile. The 'loft' operation is strictly limited to a single transition between a rectangle and a circle, which cannot approximate the multi-stage curvature of the vase profile.
